description: Owner decisions for handbook wording the models could not settle. Each entry is a set of example results with the expected decision; the pipeline accepts only a model rule set that reproduces every case (review_basis owner_interpretation). Case subjects may carry a grade ('Physics:C', default S) and a case may give the student's stream.

interpretations.reading: '(i) At least one of the following subjects ... and (ii) The other subject/ subjects from the following list': at least one subject comes from list (i). All three subjects from list (i) is eligible; when only one or two come from list (i), the remaining subject(s) must come from list (ii). A subject in neither list is not eligible.
interpretations.basis: Owner reading of ambiguous wording; not stated verbatim in the handbook.
interpretations.previous_reading: one or two subjects from list (i), the rest from list (ii); all three from list (i) not eligible (2026-11-11)

interpretations.reading: Four ways: (1) Biological Science stream, (2) Physical Science stream, (3) two Biological Science subjects + Information & Communication Technology, (4) two Physical Science subjects + Information & Communication Technology. The two subjects in (3)/(4) come from the same stream (stream_subjects); the 'C' grade clause applies to every way.
interpretations.basis: Owner stream-subject lists (stream_subjects); not stated in the handbook.

programme_rules.reading: 'To enter into some degree programmes such as Accountancy, Auditing & Forensic Accounting and Finance in a university, students should have offered Accounting as a subject at the G.C.E. (Advanced Level) Examination' (stated in 2.2.2.4): every listed degree programme named for Accountancy/Accounting, Auditing, Finance/Financial, Banking or Insurance requires Accounting as an A/L subject; the owner extends it to the programmes listed in 2.2.2.5 (Trincomalee Campus).

stream_subjects.basis: Common G.C.E. (A/L) stream practice stated by the project owner; the UGC handbook does not list the subjects of each stream. Mathematics (07) and Higher Mathematics are not counted as science-stream subjects.
